X-ray.definition: v. examine by taking x-rays\nv. take an x-ray of something or somebody
X-ray.translation: a. X射线的\nvt. 用X光检查, 照X光\nvi. 使用X光

examples.en: The doctors are looking at an X-ray.
The X-ray showed two broken fingers.
examples.zh: X光片显示两根手指断了。

examples.en: The doctor used X-rays to examine my stomach.

phrase.cn: 胸部x光片；胸腔X 光摄影
爱克斯光管；爱克斯射线管

xenophobia.definition: n. a fear of foreigners or strangers
xenophobia.translation: n. 无端畏惧和憎恨外国人/陌生人, 对外国人的畏惧和憎恨\n[医] 生客恐怖

examples.en: "Marko, what's the Yellow Peril?" "Dennis, it's xenophobia!"
Xenophobia is a widespread attitude in ghettos.
Trump is known for his xenophobia.

xerox.definition: n. a copy made by a xerographic printer\nn. a duplicator (trade mark Xerox) that copies graphic matter by the action of light on an electrically charged photoconductive insulating surface in which the latent image is developed with a resinous powder

examples.en: I mistook the shredder for a Xerox machine.
